g.text: Inception AI • Complete User Interaction Flowchart
How engineering students, makers, and university clubs interact with AI discovery, hardware procurement, and circuit debugging.
Path A: AI Project Discovery & Matching
1. Student inputs: Target Budget (₹ INR) + Domain (IoT, Robotics, AIoT)
2. Model generates 3 feasible hardware projects tailored to skill level
3. Outputs: Estimated build time, full BOM, and learning milestones
1. Browse by microcontrollers: ESP32, Arduino Uno, RP2040, STM32
2. Single-part purchase or 1-Click complete project kits
3. Real-time stock status, college pricing & pin-compatibility badges
Path C: AI Hardware & Firmware Troubleshooter
1. Student describes symptom: "ESP32 brownout reboot" or "I2C 0x3C not found"
2. AI performs root-cause fault diagnosis (pull-ups, power surge, pinout clash)
3. Returns: 4 Physical Wiring Checks + Ready-to-flash C++ Code Fix
Path D: Interactive Learning Lab & Tutorials
• Pinout tables (GPIO, ADC, PWM, I2C, SPI)
• Component Deep-Dives: "Why do I need an optocoupler?"
Save Money: "Only Buy What You Need"
• Student unchecks components they already possess in their lab
• Cart recalculates instantly in ₹ INR with bulk student discount
• University Name (e.g., IIT Bombay, NIT Trichy, VIT)
• Hostel Block & Room Number (e.g. Block C, Room 304)
• UPI QR (GPay / PhonePe / Paytm) • NetBanking • Cash on Delivery (COD)
SMS & Email updates at every checkpoint
• Student unboxes hardware & follows interactive guide
• Stumble upon wiring issue? 1-Click AI Troubleshoot
• Publishes build to Maker Showcase for peer feedback

svg.text: Loop: Real-Time Debugging Support during Assembly
